description: Independent bounded video encoder. Software compression/native encoding, stream rate policy and packet ownership stay in this library; image production, clocks, presentation and network keep their owners.

functions.name: open

operation.ownership: Caller serializes each owner; independent streams may progress concurrently. Providers remain loaded through final retirement acknowledgement.

functions.description: Bind real process/platform providers and finite runtime budget; does not activate an encoder.

functions.name: query_caps

operation.ownership: Caller serializes each owner; independent streams may progress concurrently. Providers remain loaded through final retirement acknowledgement.

functions.description: Query actual implemented profile and backend. Unsupported never silently selects software.

functions.name: create

operation.ownership: Caller serializes each owner; independent streams may progress concurrently. Providers remain loaded through final retirement acknowledgement.

functions.description: Reserve budgets and create one asynchronous stream outside paint or input handling.

functions.name: send

operation.ownership: Caller serializes each owner; independent streams may progress concurrently. Providers remain loaded through final retirement acknowledgement.

functions.description: Accept exactly one immutable image loan; AGAIN/error accepts nothing. Never encode or wait for GPU in this call.

functions.name: receive

operation.ownership: Caller serializes each owner; independent streams may progress concurrently. Providers remain loaded through final retirement acknowledgement.

functions.description: Acquire the next completion packet; AGAIN means none ready, EOS follows completed Drain and output exhaustion. Failure leaves output unchanged.

functions.name: release

operation.ownership: Caller serializes each owner; independent streams may progress concurrently. Providers remain loaded through final retirement acknowledgement.

functions.description: Release immutable packet storage after readers finish. Pending release keeps the exact token for retry; acknowledged tokens must not be retried after slot reuse.

functions.name: control

operation.ownership: Caller serializes each owner; independent streams may progress concurrently. Providers remain loaded through final retirement acknowledgement.

functions.description: Queue/query Drain, Abort or Close. Query creates no work; workers retire inputs/resources. Close never revokes leased packets.

functions.name: destroy

operation.ownership: Caller serializes each owner; independent streams may progress concurrently. Providers remain loaded through final retirement acknowledgement.

functions.description: Remove an acknowledged closed owner only after worker and packet retirement. BUSY retains the handle.

functions.name: finish

operation.ownership: Caller serializes each owner; independent streams may progress concurrently. Providers remain loaded through final retirement acknowledgement.

functions.description: After encoder destruction, stop/join runtime workers and release process-local state. Finite timeout preserves an unfinished owner for retry.

interfaces.description: Independent asynchronous image-to-bitstream API with physical input retirement and immutable output leases.

types.name: R4EncRuntime
types.description: Process-local owner. The provider remains loaded through acknowledged destruction.

types.name: R4EncEncoder
types.description: Process-local owner. The provider remains loaded through acknowledged destruction.

fields.name: application

fields.name: memory_limit

fields.name: max_encoders

fields.name: thread_limit

types.description: Copied runtime policy; opening alone creates no encode work.

types.name: R4EncCapsQuery

fields.name: backend

fields.name: adapter_id
fields.description: Exact native adapter; zero for software.

fields.name: profile
fields.description: Codec profile; zero resolves the installed default.

types.description: Query an implemented profile and its actual backend admission.

types.name: R4EncCaps

fields.name: max_level
fields.description: Largest codec level; exact geometry/frame-rate must also pass create.

fields.name: device_generation
fields.description: Exact native device generation; zero for software.

fields.name: reset_generation
fields.description: Exact native reset generation; zero for software.

types.description: Capability is implementation admission, never physical encoder qualification.

types.name: R4EncRate

fields.name: mode
fields.description: CQP, CBR or VBR; must be present in caps.rate_modes.

fields.name: qp
fields.description: Constant/initial luma QP in codec units.

fields.name: target_bps
fields.description: Target bits per second; zero in constant-QP mode.

fields.name: peak_bps
fields.description: Peak bits per second, at least target; zero in CQP mode.

fields.name: buffer_bits
fields.description: Finite coded-picture budget in bits. Zero is required for CQP; other modes require a positive supported budget.

types.description: Copied immutable rate policy. Quality/performance presets are not guessed from vendor SDK names.

types.name: R4EncBuffer
types.description: ABI-compatible view of a common graphics BO/reference handle, not a CPU address.

types.name: R4EncFence
types.description: Canonical common queue fence layout. All-zero means no consumer GPU submission; any nonzero value must be exact.

types.name: R4EncColor

fields.name: size
fields.description: Must equal the complete fixed payload size.

fields.name: primaries
fields.description: CICP color_primaries code point from stream; 2 means unspecified. Not an R4GFX RGB enum.

fields.name: transfer
fields.description: CICP transfer_characteristics code point from stream; 2 means unspecified. Do not substitute sRGB for BT.709.

fields.name: range
fields.description: Common range identity: 0 unknown, 1 full, 2 limited at bit_depth. No guessed default.

fields.name: matrix
fields.description: CICP matrix_coefficients code point from stream; 2 means unspecified. Independent of primaries and transfer.

fields.name: chroma_location
fields.description: Chroma sample position relative to luma.

fields.name: bit_depth
fields.description: Number of meaningful bits per component.

fields.name: reference_white
fields.description: Reference-white luminance in 1/10000 cd/m2; valid only with color_reference_white, otherwise zero.

fields.name: peak
fields.description: Peak luminance in 1/10000 cd/m2; valid only with color_luminance, otherwise zero.

fields.name: black
fields.description: Black luminance in 1/10000 cd/m2; valid only with color_luminance, otherwise zero.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: color_reference_white and color_luminance only. Missing metadata is preserved; policy belongs to presentation.

types.description: Immutable stream color metadata. Conversion, scaling and output color policy belong to R4GFX/Desktop.

types.name: R4EncPlane

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Caller-owned readable reference; independently retained after send acceptance.

types.description: Input view validated against the actual BO descriptor. Never infer linear storage from pitch.

types.name: R4EncConfig

fields.name: max_packet_bytes
fields.description: Hard access-unit allocation limit; overflow is a reported failure.

fields.name: gop_frames
fields.description: Positive maximum accepted pictures between IDRs.

fields.name: color
fields.description: Explicit encoded color metadata; no inferred HDR.

types.description: Create reserves all finite budgets. Revision1 uses one encode worker per stream and no B-frame reorder. Reconfigure by closing and opening at a new IDR.

types.name: R4EncFrame

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Caller input identity returned exactly in its completion packet.

fields.name: duration_ns
fields.description: Positive media duration; never a wall-clock tick.

fields.name: ready
fields.description: Borrowed producer completion fence, retained by caller through input completion.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Force-IDR flag; first frame and post-abort frame always become IDR.

types.description: Send copies metadata and retains deduplicated BO references. Caller keeps all pixels immutable until receive returns the matching completion or control confirms all prior inputs retired.

types.name: R4EncLease

fields.name: encoder
fields.description: Exact owner retained until packet release.

fields.name: token
fields.description: Non-reused packet token within owner lifetime.

fields.name: stream_generation
fields.description: Generation which produced the packet; retained across Abort.

types.description: Immutable process-local output lease. A control request never revokes a delivered packet.

types.name: R4EncPacket

fields.name: lease
fields.description: Exact packet lease, including skipped-frame receipts.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Input tag; this receipt also ends its immutable input loan.

fields.name: dts_ns
fields.description: Decode timestamp; equals PTS in the no-B-frame profile.

fields.name: data_address
fields.description: Read-only process-local bytes held until release; zero for a skipped frame.

fields.name: data_bytes
fields.description: Complete Annex-B access unit, including SPS/PPS for each IDR; zero for a skipped frame.

fields.name: result
fields.description: Zero for encoded output, skip reason for explicit dropped-frame receipt.

types.description: Receive returns accepted inputs in encode order after physical input retirement. Only compressed output is made CPU-readable in a native path; no full-image readback.

types.name: R4EncControl

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Strictly increasing mutation ID. Query uses zero; identical latest retries are idempotent.

types.description: Nonblocking request acceptance is distinct from completion. Abort cancels unstarted inputs, retires active work and starts a new stream generation at an IDR.

types.name: R4EncState

fields.name: stream_generation
fields.description: Starts at1; successful Abort advances once after all old inputs retire.

fields.name: pending_request
fields.description: Accepted incomplete control ID or zero.

fields.name: memory_bytes
fields.description: Charged owned bytes including old-generation packet leases.

fields.name: last_error
fields.description: Sticky terminal encode/backend error; Close remains legal.

types.description: Read-only progress. Drain preserves outputs and ends in EOS. Abort/Close discard unleased output, but retain externally delivered packets through release.

ownership_rules.name: Immutable input
ownership_rules.text: Send success retains metadata and common BO references. Source pixels and the producer fence remain immutable until the matching receive receipt or completed Abort/Close. Busy/error accepts nothing.

ownership_rules.name: Physical completion
ownership_rules.text: Logical timeout/cancel never frees active GPU resources. Input receipt follows engine and mapping retirement; packet and provider lifetimes remain reachable on errors.

ownership_rules.name: Output ownership
ownership_rules.text: Receive supplies one complete access unit or an explicit skipped-input receipt. Data is read-only until release. Delivered leases survive Abort and Close.

ownership_rules.name: Backpressure
ownership_rules.text: Queues and byte budgets are finite. Consumer chooses frames to omit before Send; no silent replacement of an accepted input. Slow output never blocks local presentation.

ownership_rules.name: Control identity
ownership_rules.text: Strictly increasing mutation IDs; identical pending retries do not repeat work. Accepted differs from completed. Abort/Close may supersede pending Drain, and Close may supersede Abort. Retrying a superseded ID returns CANCELLED or STALE, never success. Abort advances generation only after old inputs retire; first new input is IDR.

ownership_rules.name: Errors
ownership_rules.text: A failed control preserves the old stream generation. Close/release/query remain possible. Failed encode never publishes partial bytes as success.

ownership_rules.name: Media time
ownership_rules.text: PTS/duration belong to the caller timeline. Revision1 has no B-frame reorder. No wall clock, hidden frame scheduler or network transport exists inside the encoder.

ownership_rules.name: Format and color
ownership_rules.text: Canonical BO descriptors retain placement, modifier and device epoch. Explicit CICP metadata is immutable per stream; unknown or unsupported color/layout is rejected.

ownership_rules.name: Activation
ownership_rules.text: Opening a runtime or querying capabilities produces no encode work. Only explicit accepted frame input in an admitted encoder may activate the engine.

ownership_rules.name: Implementation status
ownership_rules.text: This is the 0.79.41 implementation target. Generated contracts do not imply a working codec or physical qualification.
